desks.Dividends: Apple goes ex-dividend Thu Nov 12 at $0.27 per quarter, unchanged, payable Nov 16. Microsoft goes ex-dividend Thu Nov 19 at $0.98, the first payment at the raised rate (+7.7%) and its 24th consecutive annual increase, payable Dec 10. Nvidia has not yet declared its fourth-quarter dividend; the historical pattern points to a declaration around Nov 19-20, with an ex-date likely in early December (UNVERIFIED). SPY and QQQ have no ex-dates in the window. Tesla pays no dividend.
desks.Earnings: Nvidia is the only watchlist name reporting in the window, Tue Nov 17 after close, with consensus EPS of $2.49 (Nasdaq, 13 estimates). Options imply a move of about 9.3% (Nov 18 at-the-money straddle $16.12 on a $173.73 underlying), roughly double the 5.6% average actual move over the last 12 reports. Premium into a binary event is to be avoided. Apple, Microsoft and Tesla reported in the last three weeks; their next prints are estimated for late January 2027 (UNVERIFIED, unconfirmed).
desks.Futures: The November WASDE landed Tue Nov 10, bullish for grains: corn yield 179.6 bushels per acre and ending stocks 1.758 billion bushels, both below consensus; soybean ending stocks 300 million bushels, well below the 336 million consensus. December corn rose 9 3/4 cents and January soybeans 39 3/4 cents on the day. Brent settled $91.49 per barrel Nov 10 and rebounded about 1-2% today as Hormuz attacks continued. The EIA weekly petroleum report is delayed to Thu Nov 12 at noon ET; the API preview is UNVERIFIED. OPEC's November report, released today, left demand forecasts unchanged and showed producer output up 2.04 million barrels per day in October.
desks.Parity: No new SPY or QQQ parity-violation report or index-methodology change was published in the last 24 hours. S&P Dow Jones Indices announced Oct 28 a revision to its U.S. growth/value classification rules, effective before the open on Dec 21, with preliminary files from Dec 4: 12-month price momentum is removed from growth rankings and value adds free-cash-flow-to-price and an intangibles-adjusted book-to-price. This is a style-classification change, not a change to S&P 500 membership or weighting, so there is no direct SPY or QQQ basket or parity implication. The current live SPX box-spread rate is UNVERIFIED.
desks.Premium: All six verdicts are WINDOW-CONTINGENT. The Nov 5 crash day still drives 42-54% of each 20-day realized-variance window (SPY 53.6%, QQQ 44.4%, AAPL 49.8%, MSFT 42.5%, NVDA 45.0%, TSLA 46.1%). Live 1-day IV is 9.86% on SPY and 17.99% on QQQ; Nvidia is the only name with IV above trailing realized (56.6% STALE, earnings-driven), and that tenor has now expired. IV rank and term structure are UNVERIFIED for all six names: no free IV-history source is available and only the nearest tenor was pulled.
desks.Quant lab: Seven new candidates were scored and added to the ledger (#254-260), 2 WATCH, 5 ARCHIVE, with no TEST or INTEGRATE movement. #255 (score 59, WATCH) is point-in-time earnings-call encoders: 412,248 calls, yearly vintages 2010-2024, each reading only text dated on or before its cutoff; call-only vintages beat general retrievers every test quarter, and the 2024 vintage forecasts earnings surprises better. Source-reported claims are UNVERIFIED; the code link and license were not verified this run. Next step: verify the repository, then sandbox a vintage encoder on a watchlist earnings-call window.

A tanker was struck northeast of Lima, Oman on Nov 10; 37 ships were attacked in October and at least 10 in the first 10 days of November. EIA's November outlook sees Brent near $100 per barrel through year-end, about $7-8 above futures. items.detail: FRED as of Nov 9 (Nov 10-11 are a bond-market holiday): the effective federal funds rate is 3.88%, the 2-year Treasury 4.56%, and the 10-year 4.88%, putting the 2s10s slope at +32 basis points, down from 47 on Oct 5. The front end rose 10 basis points over the past week against 4 at the long end, so the market is pricing less near-term easing. SOFR minus the effective funds rate is 0 basis points — no funding stress.
